title: New Fairy Tail Manga Miniseries to Start 1 Week Sooner on July 29
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for manga creator Hiro Mashima reported on Wednesday that his new Fairy Tail manga miniseries will launch a week earlier than previously announced. The miniseries will now start in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine , which will ship on July 29.
author: ANN

title: Lupin III Composer, Jazz Pianist Yuji Ohno Dies at 84
content: Musician and composer Yuji Ohno 's official website announced on Wednesday that Ohno died of natural causes on May 4. He was 84. Ohno's production company Office Augusta noted that he died after going to sleep, without any change in his prior condition before going to sleep.
author: ANN

title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters Soccer Game Launches on August 28
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced in a new trailer on Tuesday that Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters , a new soccer game based on Yōichi Takahashi 's Captain Tsubasa manga, will launch on August 28 for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Patlabor the Case Files Game's 2nd Video Unveils Summer Launch
content: Publisher Good Smile Company and developer Chime Corporation announced on Tuesday that Patlabor the Case Files , a new 3D action game based on the Patlabor franchise, will launch this summer for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Man Arrested for Alleged Bomb Threat Against Nintendo Headquarters
content: The Kyoto Prefectural Police arrested an unemployed 27-year-old man on Tuesday for allegedly sending a bomb threat to the Nintendo headquarters in Kyoto. According to the authorities, the Hekinan CIty resident admitted to the charge of obstructing a business by force.
author: ANN

title: The Cosplay Trackside Event at Santa Anita Park Will Bring Real-Life Umamusume to California
content: The global surge in Umamusume cosplay events continues! A cosplay meetup is coming to Santa Anita Park this coming Saturday (May 16). And with otaku and non-otaku activities, the Cosplay Trackside eventis bound to be an enjoyable day for the whole family.
author: Anime Corner

title: Former Tekken Game Producer Katsuhiro Harada Launches VS Studio SNK
content: The game company SNK announced in a video on Tuesday the launch of a new game studio VS Studio SNK led by the Tekken game franchise's former producer Katsuhiro Harada . SNK has invested in the studio as its consolidated subsidiary, and both companies will collaborate on game software development.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Star Joins The Biggest Fantasy of The Year’s Crew As New Character
content: Almost a decade since the manga’s debut, Witch Hat Atelier finally premiered its highly anticipated anime on Crunchyroll as part of the Spring 2026 lineup. The anime was confirmed in 2022 and was supposed to be released in 2025, but the production took longer than expected, and fans can see why.
